title: enhance_speech output
description: The enhanced 48 kHz mono 16-bit PCM WAV as base64, with honest coverage when the caller's result budget capped the returned audio. There is no fixed maximum duration: the cap is derived from the invocation's maxResultBytes at run time, so no maxLength is declared here (a deployment that raises the budget must not be rejected by this schema).

audio_base64.description: A complete RIFF/WAVE file, 16-bit PCM mono 48 kHz, encoded as standard base64 with no data: prefix. Size is bounded by the invocation's maxResultBytes, not by this schema.

sampleRate.description: Always 48000: the returned audio is resampled to 48 kHz.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of the RETURNED audio (96,000 bytes of PCM per second). When the result budget capped it, this is shorter than the input and coverage.complete is false.

complete.description: False when the result budget capped the returned audio.

processedSeconds.description: Seconds of audio returned (equal to durationSeconds).

reason.description: Why the audio was capped; present only when complete is false.
